\begin{restated}{Lemma}{lem:L1}{A3}{1}{L1: unbiasedness and variance of the estimator; Lemma~6 of \cite{kovalev2020dont}}
For all $t$, $\Ei[g_t]=\Fp(x_t)$ and
\begin{align*}
\Ei\norm{g_t-\Fp(x_t)}^2 &= \frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n\norm{\fip(x_t)-\fip(w_t)}^2-\norm{\Fp(x_t)-\Fp(w_t)}^2
\;\le\;\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n\norm{\fip(x_t)-\fip(w_t)}^2 \tag{\ref*{ineq:var-center}}\\
&\le\;2L\,\big(F(w_t)-F(x_t)-\inner{\Fp(x_t)}{w_t-x_t}\big)\;=\;2L\,D_F(w_t,x_t). \tag{\ref*{ineq:var-coco}}
\end{align*}
We call \eqref{ineq:var-center} the \emph{centering inequality} and \eqref{ineq:var-coco} the \emph{co-coercivity bound}; their product is the \emph{variance bound}
\postdisplaypenalty=10000 \begin{equation*}\tag{\ref*{ineq:var}}
\Ei\norm{g_t-\Fp(x_t)}^2\le 2L\,D_F(w_t,x_t).
\end{equation*}
\end{restated}
